Exact crop from the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side; cover "official text as of April 27, 2013"), PDF page 31: the slip of •Strong Is Vader. It prints the text of version PC-E4, [[Strong Is Vader (Errata 4)]] (the current text). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “89”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]] (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
